Commentary.Commentary: West Indies' seamers were a mixed bag. They were good and probing with the new ball, utilizing the fresh conditions beautifully but faltered big time in the slog overs. The spinners, Nurse and Bishoo were very tidy and kept the run flow in check. Overall, the target is definitely on par considering the surface but not impossible to get. The new ball will be vital to the chase. The Windies innings isn't far away.

A fairly good batting performance by India after being put into bat. It wasn't an ideal start for them with Dhawan and Kohli falling cheaply but Rahane hung in to register yet another fifty. It was a two-paced surface with uneven bounce and he anchored the innings along with Yuvraj who failed to convert a start. Once the southpaw departed, Dhoni stepped in and produced a well-paced unbeaten fifty to get India past the 250-run mark. Jadhav played a beautiful cameo as well as India racked up 100 runs off the last 10 overs.

FOUR! FINISHES WITH A BANG! Typical of a Dhoni finish. Not a biggie but a boundary will do. Fuller ball outside off, easy pickings for Dhoni who lifts it easily past mid off to find the fence. INDIA END ON 251/4.
On a length outside off, crashed towards cover for a single.

FOUR! TOP EDGE BUT GETS RUNS! The short ball is troubling Jadhav but he gets away this time. Tries to pull the bumper but gets a big top edge. It goes easily over the keeper's head and almost goes all the way.
Jadhav is cramped by a bouncer and is forced to duck under it.

FOUR! Up and over! Cannot bowl that length with mid off up. Fuller and outside off, Jadhav gets across a touch and lifts it over the mid off fielder to find the fence. A bit aerial but cleared the infield easily.
Cleverly bowled! Shortens the length as Jadhav backs away to make room. Ducks as Williams follows him with a well-directed bumper.
Full toss outside off, Dhoni slaps it through the covers for a brace.
Fullish on middle, whipped away to long on for a single.
Shortish and outside off, Dhoni cuts uppishly over point. Falls safe in the deep as Bishoo tidies up. Single taken.
Wide! Short but down the leg side, Dhoni misses the pull and it's a wide.
On middle and leg, whipped away on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Fab stroke! Jadhav was on one knee even before the delivery was bowled but Cummins wasn't clever enough to change his length. It's a good length ball wider outside off and Kedar lofts it easily over square leg to find the fence. This is an excellent phase for India in the slog overs. Slowly, they are getting to a score that could be very hard to get on this track.
On a shorter length outside off, mistimed shot towards long on for a single.
Slower ball outside off, Dhoni taps it to the off side for a single.
Top edge but safe! Premeditated charge from Jadhav again but the length is shorter. He tries to play the big stroke but gets a top edge that falls safe on the leg side. Single taken.
On a length outside off, Dhoni taps it towards point for a single.
Fuller on off stump, Jadhav walks a bit and whips it towards short fine leg where the fielder puts in a decent stop. Single taken.
50-run stand between Kedar Jadhav and MS Dhoni.
SIX! LAUNCHED! The slower ball but Jadhav has picked it early. Waits for it and mows this over wide long on for a big maximum. Clean bat swing and that went deep into the stands.
Fuller on off stump, Jadhav bunts it back to the bowler. Dot to start the over.
Fullish outside off, drilled down the ground to the left of long on as the batsmen get a brace. Big over, 17 off it.
Wide! On a length well outside off, left alone to the keeper and that's a wide.
Fullish outside off, Jadhav mistimes the drive towards long off for a single.
Very full and outside off, Jadhav gets a bottom edge on to that one.
Length ball outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.

SIX! KABOOM! He's on the charge now. Holder's losing the plot, another full ball and gets the treatment. Dhoni walks across the sticks and propels this over deep mid-wicket for a maximum with a strong whip. Terrific shot! Brilliantly done.
SIX! CLOBBERED! That's Dhoni at his very best. Fullish and outside off, he gets under it and launches it straight down the ground for a maximum. Clears long off with ease. Superb hit!
Fuller on leg stump, Dhoni walks down the track but misses the flick. The ball goes off the pads towards square leg as the batsmen cross. No signal from the umpire, so perhaps a tiny edge.
Low full toss on off stump, wristed powerfully towards long on for a single.
Beaten! Slower and a bit short outside off, Jadhav charges down the track and has a swat at it but is beaten for the lack of pace.
Short of a length outside off, tapped towards point for a single.
Fuller and around off, driven fluently to cover for a single.
Slower and almost in the blockhole on off stump, Dhoni waits and eases it past the bowler towards long on. Single taken.
63rd ODI fifty for Dhoni.
Fullish outside off, Dhoni drills it through the covers for a single to reach the milestone. It's been a smartly paced knock from him so far, can he finish well?
Very full and around off stump, Jadhav gets a thick inside edge on to the pads. They sneak through for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Jadhav carves it through backward point for a brace.

FOUR! CHEEKY FROM JADHAV! This is what he can do in the death overs, he can really hurt the bowling side. Walks across the pitch in a premediated fashion and takes full toll of the full toss. Scoops it over square leg and picks the gap well to find the boundary. Smart batting!
Fuller and outside off, Dhoni pushes it through the covers for a single.
Fullish outside off, Jadhav shuffles a bit and propels it through mid-wicket with a strong bottom hand to get a single.
Jason Holder is back.

Nervy moment for Jadhav! Gives a premeditated charge but the length is on the shorter side. Tries to go through with the shot but skews it high in the air. Luckily for him, it falls safe at square leg. Single taken.
Very full and outside off, jammed towards cover for a single.
On a length outside off, Jadhav waits longer this time before opening the bat face. Gets it past short third man and it trickles towards the deep as the batsmen get three.
Slower ball outside off, nicely bowled variation and Jadhav is beaten on the drive. Totally bamboozled by the lack of pace.
Good length closer to off stump, Dhoni taps it towards point for a quick single.
Low full toss outside off, slapped through the covers for a single.
Fullish on middle, dug out towards long on for a single.
Fine yorker around off, dug out to extra cover for a single.

FOUR! Finds the fence! Dhoni is having a move on now. Fuller ball outside off, he eases it through backward point. Uses the bowler's pace well and third man had no chance of cutting that off despite the long boundaries.
Dhoni premeditates the paddle scoop and gets it over short fine leg. Brace taken.
Kedar Jadhav is the next man in.

OUT! SUPERB FROM BISHOO! Couldn't get to the previous one but has taken an excellent catch this time. Short of a length outside off, Rahane cuts it uppishly over backward point. In the air and Bishoo from deep cover-point races forward to his left to take a brilliant diving catch near deep backward point. A solid knock from Rahane ends as he tries to up the ante.

AERIAL BUT JUST SAFE! Back of a length outside off, Rahane lofts it over the covers. In the air for a while but just falls short near sweeper cover as Bishoo makes a stop just near the ropes. They check upstairs but the third umpire feels it's a neat stop. Brace added.
Wide! Shorter and well wide outside off, left alone and that shall be a wide.
Miguel Cummins returns for another spell.
Back of a length around off, Rahane looks to whip it but is struck on the pads. Appeal for lbw but there was a faint inside edge there. The batsmen cross for a run.
Back of a length outside off, steered towards point for a single.
On a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Dhoni opens the bat face to steer it but gets it uppishly towards short third man. Almost carried to Powell stationed there. Single taken.
Back of a length on off stump, manipulated towards square leg for a single.
Shortish on leg stump, Dhoni gets across to fend and is struck high on the bat as the ball rolls towards short fine leg. Single taken.
Kesrick Williams is back on.
A bit short outside off, crunched towards long off for a single.
Floated outside off, the sweep from Rahane fetches him a single towards deep mid-wicket.
Shorter length this time, cut away to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! SMACKED! That's struck with brute force. Very full and outside off, Dhoni launches it over the bowler's head. Struck it really hard and the man at long off had no chance of cutting it off.
Wide! Dhoni gives the charge but then aborts the shot. It was too wide and given by the umpire.
Loopy outside off, Rahane uses his feet and carves it over the covers. Wasn't quite in control but gets it over the infield. Single taken.
On a length outside off, slapped away to sweeper cover for a single.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders now allowed till the end of the innings.
Drifting in around middle, worked away on the leg side. Ends a very tidy spell from Nurse, 10-0-34-0.
Floated on middle, wristed away to long on for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single. Brings up the 50-run stand.
Fuller outside off, Rahane drives but cannot get it through the gap at cover.
Drifting in from outside off, dabbed towards point.
Floated on middle and leg, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, dug out towards the man at cover.

DROPPED! Dhoni escapes again. Steps out to play a booming drive but the length isn't quite there. Slices it to short third man where Kyle Hope dives across to get his hands on it but doesn't hold on to it. He'll be disappointed, especially after the blinder he took to remove Kohli.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly towards cover.
MISHIT BUT FALLS SAFE! Dhoni has a slice of luck. Goes for a mighty slog sweep but skews it high in the air. Luckily for him, it just falls in no man's land at deep mid on. Brace taken.
Flatter and short outside off, flat-batted past the bowler down the ground. Long off gets across to his right to save a couple for his side.
Flighted outside off, driven towards long off for a single.
Fullish outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Fuller on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked gently to the leg side.
Drifting in from outside off, steered to short third man.
Floated outside off, Dhoni leans forward and glides it past backward point.  In the gap and he will pick up two.
Fuller outside off, Dhoni eases it towards cover, one-handed shot but cannot pick the gap.
Flatter outside off, Dhoni sits back to pull but mistimes it to long on for a single.

FOUR! BANG! A boundary finally for Dhoni and this should get him going. Floated wider outside off, he winds up for the booming shot and gets it straight down the ground. There was a man at long on but he couldn't get across in time. Typical MS shot, raw power!
Flatter outside off, Dhoni cuts it towards the off side but cannot pick the gap.
Floated on a length outside off, Dhoni looks to drive but then lets it pass.
Full and on off stump, Dhoni winds up for the big drive but can only drill it back to the bowler.
Flighted outside off, Rahane uses his feet and drives it down to long off for a single.
Loopy on middle and leg, clipped away on the leg side for a single.
Floated outside off, Dhoni drills it down the ground to long off for a single.
Floated around middle, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Floated on off stump, driven well but straight back to the bowler.
Drifting in around off stump, Rahane sweeps but cannot beat the fielder at square leg.
A bit short outside off, Rahane goes back to cut but mistimes it towards cover.
Ashley Nurse is back.
Drinks has been taken.
Again outside off, Dhoni punches it towards the fielder at covers. A brilliant over from Bishoo.
Again towards the fielder at point. Dhoni is quite frustrated with it.
A bit short outside off, Dhoni cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Wide! Sprayed way wide outside off, Dhoni lets it through. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Dhoni camps back and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller outside off, Dhoni goes after it but fails to make contact.
Tossed up outside off, Dhoni cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery around middle and off, Rahane punches it straight back to the bowler who makes a good stop.
Another short delivery into the batsman, Rahane tries to ramp it over the keeper but fails to make contact.

SIX! Rahane seems to be done with the waiting game! Predicts the short delivery well in advance, stands tall on it and pulls it powerfully over the mid-wicket region for a biggie. The replays confirm that it was a maximum.
Another short delivery into the batsman, Dhoni shuffles a bit and guides it towards fine leg for a single.
Short delivery into the body, Dhoni works it towards the fielder at square leg.
Back of a length delivery in the line of the stumps, Dhoni defends it towards the fielder at mid on.
Another quicker delivery outside off, Rahane punches it off the back foot but straight to the fielder at covers.
Tossed up around off, Dhoni punches it through covers for a single.
Quicker one outside off, Dhoni shoulders his arms to it.
Replica of the last delivery, and Dhoni plays the same shot.
Floated outside off, Dhoni cuts but straight to the fielder at point.
Floated around off, Dhoni comes forward and tries to defend it. Gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Short delivery into the batsman, Dhoni stands tall and defends it beside the pitch on the leg side for a quick single.
Another back of a length delivery, stays low. Rahane still manages to pull it towards fine leg for a single.
Another short delivery and the ball bounces a bit more off the deck. Rahane gets surprised as he tries to go for the pull.
Short delivery into the batsman, Dhoni pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Dhoni punches it towards covers off the back foot.
Leg bye! Angling into the pads, Rahane fails to clip it through but he gets rapped on the pads. The batsmen run a leg bye.
Jason Holder is back for a bowl.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Quicker outside off, Dhoni cannot get his bat down in time and he fails to make contact this time.
A bit short around off, Dhoni punches it off the back foot towards the fielder at point.
Driven towards long off for a single.
Tossed outside off, Dhoni slashes at it. Gets an outside edge and the ball goes past the keeper for a single.
Fired outside off, Dhoni lets it through to the keeper.
The physio is out in the middle to treat MS Dhoni. He seems to have some problem with his right palm.

Lucky! Short delivery around off, Dhoni stays tall and tries to defend it. Gets an outside edge on it and the ball flies through the gap between the keeper and the slip fielder. The batsmen run a single. Cummins is not having his share of luck.
Rahane clips one on the leg side for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Dhoni cuts it through the point region for a triple.
Dhoni stays behind the line of the ball and defends it.
18th ODI fifty for Ajinkya Rahane!

Fifty for Rahane! What a knock this has been by the opener. None of the batsmen have looked comfortable on this wicket and he has marched onto another fifty in this series. He will look to make the most of it and try and go on to hit a century. Coming back to the ball, Ajinkya just stays back in the crease and runs it down towards third man for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Rahane mistimes his cut towards the fielder at point. He is just a run short of his fifty. Such a solid knock by the Mumbai lad this has been.
Fuller outside off, Rahane drives it towards long off for a single.
Rahane camps back and punches it through covers but he cannot beat the fielder at covers.
A bit short outside off, allows Dhoni to camp back and cut through the point region for a single.
Outside off, Dhoni comes down the track and clips it towards the fielder at mid on.
Again floated wide outside off, Rahane punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Dhoni stays deep in his crease and punches it through covers for a single.
Short delivery into the batsman, Dhoni pulls it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery around off, Dhoni tries to defend it but gets hit on the glove.
Short delivery into the batsman, Rahane shuffles and clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Sprayed down the leg side, Dhoni flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Another short delivery into the batsman, Rahane fends it on the leg side for a quick single.
Short delivery into the body, Dhoni nudges it towards backward square leg for a single.
Miguel Cummins is brought back into the attack.
Wrong 'un outside off, Rahane punches it off the back foot straight back to the bowler.
Eased down to long on for a single.
Dhoni gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Floated outside off, Dhoni drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
MS Dhoni strides out to the middle.

OUT! A brilliant review! A floater tossed up around leg, Yuvraj Singh prods forward in defence. Fails to get bat to it and he gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested. Jason Holder consults the bowler and opts for the review. Replays show that it was pitched in line, impact was in line and it was going on to hit the off stump. End of an important stand and West Indies will look to make further inroads.
West Indies have gone upstairs to review for an LBW against Yuvraj Singh.
Tossed up outside off, Rahane mistimes his cut towards cover for a single.
Quicker delivery outside off, Yuvraj Singh blocks it away.
Short delivery and Yuvraj cuts it straight to backward point. No runs taken.
Fuller around off, Yuvraj drives it towards the fielder at covers.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shorter around off, Yuvraj punches it back to the bowler.
Quicker outside off, Yuvraj plays it delicately past the keeper for a couple.
Into the pads, Yuvraj works it on the leg side for a single.
Floated outside off, Rahane cuts it through covers for a single.
Fuller into the stumps, Yuvraj clips it towards long on for a single.
Another short delivery outside off, Yuvraj punches it through the extra cover region for a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Yuvraj stays in his crease and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Rahane stays back and punches it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! A bit off the top edge! Sprayed down the leg side, Yuvraj gets a freebie as he sweeps it over the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Rahane drives it towards long on for a single.
Mild shout for LBW! Tossed around middle and leg, Rahane tries to clip it through. The ball stays low and he gets an inside edge onto the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire is not interested.
Full around leg, Yuvraj eases it down towards long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Yuvraj punches it towards the bowler.
Short from Nurse and Rahane camps back and pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Yuvraj Singh gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it away.
Yuvraj clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller around leg, Yuvraj fails to clip it through and gets rapped on the pads. A mild appeal is denied as it was going down leg.
50-run stand between Yuvraj Singh and Ajinkya Rahane.
Rahane camps back and punches it towards long on for a single.
A bit short and Rahane camps back and punches it straight to the fielder at covers.
Floats this one around middle, Rahane comes forward and drives it straight back to the bowler.
Devendra Bishoo is called in for a bowl.
A bit short around off, Yuvraj Singh defends it well off the back foot.
Fuller into the stumps, Yuvraj clips it towards the mid-wicket fielder who makes a good stop.
Fuller into the stumps, Rahane wrists it towards short mid-wicket who makes a half stop which allows the batsmen to take a single.
Short around off, Yuvraj punches it towards long on for a single.
Quicker around middle and leg, Rahane camps back and clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller into the stumps, Yuvraj eases it down towards long on for a single.
Short delivery into the batsman, Rahane sways away and tries to play the ramp shot but fails to make contact.
Another slower delivery outside off at 110 kph, Rahane drives it straight towards the fielder at mid off.
Slower delivery outside off, Rahane covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Educated edge! Back of a length delivery outside off, Yuvraj guides it off the outer half towards third man for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Yuvraj gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
FOUR! Short and pulled with disdain! Short delivery and outside off, Yuvraj Singh stands tall and pulls it fluently through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Again fired outside off this time, Ajinkya camps back and defends it.
Bowls this one quicker, Rahane defends it towards the point region.
Full into the pads, Yuvraj clips it through square leg for a single.
Fuller around off, Yuvraj pushes it back to the bowler.
Rahane camps back and punches it through covers for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Yuvraj charges down the track and drives it towards long off for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Another bad ball but Lewis saves a certain boundary! Fuller outside off, Yuvraj drives it through the extra cover region where Evin Lewis puts in a dive to his left. The batsmen run a single.

FOUR! Finally a brilliant shot! Good length delivery outside off, Yuvraj cuts and he cuts hard. Through the point region for a boundary. This was delightful to watch and Williams spoils his brilliant over with this silly delivery.
Angling across from a length around off, Yuvraj Singh lets it through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Yuvraj defends it towards point.
Short delivery angling into the hips, Rahane fends it on the leg side for a quick single.
Yuvraj Singh reaches out to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, the batsman lets it through.
Quicker and drifting into the stumps, Yuvraj is taken by surprise as he somehow blocks it away.
A bit short outside off this time, YS dabs it towards gully and rushes for a single but is sent back by Rahane.
Another fuller delivery around off, Yuvraj blocks it away.
Angling into the stumps, Yuvraj prods forward and defends it.
Rahane clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Another short delivery outside off, the ball nips away as Yuvraj tries to poke at it.
The slip is back in place.

FOUR! Lucky runs! Good length delivery outside off, Yuvraj Singh tries to run it down towards third man but ends up getting a thick outside edge past the keeper for a boundary. He will be really glad that the slip was not in place there.
Short delivery and Rahane pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside off, played through covers for a single.
Angling in from a good length outside off, Rahane dabs it towards third man for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Yuvraj glides it uppishly through gully for a single. He was not in control of that shot.
Drinks break....
Drifting in from outside off, punched off the back foot towards the off side.
Flighted around middle, Yuvraj eases it down to long on for a single.
Loopy around middle, Rahane nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks it to the off side.
Floated around off stump, pushed gently towards the fielder at point.
Floated on off stump, wristed past mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, Rahane taps it towards point.
Good length around off stump, firmly blocked from the crease by Rahane.

RIPPER FROM WILLIAMS! The pitch continues to spring surprises. Short ball that keeps coming in with the angle. It rises awkwardly as well as Rahane arches his back to sway away just in time. Eventually, he falls on the ground in the process.
On the shorter side outside off, Rahane lets it pass to the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and punches it square of the wicket on the off side for a couple.

FOUR! LUCK FOR RAHANE! Short and outside off, he goes for the cut but the extra bounce undoes him a bit. Gets a thick edge that flies over the keeper's head. No chance for Shai Hope as the ball raced to the third man fence.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, Rahane fails to connect the flick. Wide called.
Slider on off stump, gets across and taps it towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks it to the off side.
Tossed up wider outside off, gracefully driven through the covers by Yuvraj. Gets a couple as the man in the deep tidies up. These are big ground dimensions.
Drifting in from outside off, Rahane punches it to long off for a single.
Flatter on middle, Rahane stays back and blocks it towards short mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Yuvraj drives it sweetly down to long off for a single.
Ashley Nurse comes on to bowl. Slip in place.
On the pads, glanced by Yuvraj to fine leg for a single.
Another shorter length outside off, Rahane flashes hard at it and gets a thickish edge that goes over the wide first slip. Third man does well to mop up as the batsmen take a single.
Shortish outside off, Rahane mistimes the back foot punch back towards the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover with the full face of the bat.
Length ball closer to off stump, defended off the back foot towards point.
On a length just around off stump, no shot offered to that one.
Kesrick Williams comes on to bowl.

MIX UP BUT SAFE! On the shorter side outside off, Rahane taps it gently to the off side with soft hands. Mix up in the running and they eventually decide to complete the single. Yuvraj could have been in trouble if the fielder had moved quickly and fired a direct hit at the keeper's end.
Short of a length on off stump, Rahane manages to fend it in time to the leg side.
Shortish outside off, enough time for Rahane to let it pass.
Back of a length outside off, Rahane lifts his bat to make a leave.
On a length around off stump, tapped gently towards point and the batsmen take a sharp single. Direct hit at the keeper's end but Rahane was well in.
Wide! Speared down the leg side, Yuvraj looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
Short of a length around off, Yuvraj goes for the pull but fails to make contact.
Length ball outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot to the off side.
Short of a length just outside off, Rahane thought about playing at it but then withdrew his blade just at the last moment.
On a length around leg stump, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Shortish around middle, Yuvraj ducks under the bumper awkwardly.
Length ball around middle, Rahane gets across and clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length around off stump, Rahane defends it solidly from the crease.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now a maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.

SNORTER! This pitch has been troubling the batsmen a lot with the extra bounce and Yuvraj is the latest one to be on the receiving end. Shortish around off stump, he just about manages to evade the bumper as that took off after pitching. Wicket maiden from Holder.
Good length closer to off stump, blocked firmly from the crease.
Back of a length on leg stump, Yuvraj manages to keep down the lifter on the leg side.
Yuvraj Singh strides out to the middle.

OUT! BLINDER BY KYLE HOPE! What a catch by the debutant and this is a massive wicket for West Indies. 50th ODI wicket for Holder and he deserved this. Kept banging it on the shorter side and the uneven bounce was unsettling Kohli for some time. On this occasion, the Indian captain pokes at it as an afterthought and gets an edge. In the last over, the edge had fallen safe but this time Kyle at gully dives to his left to take a stunner, a brilliant one-handed take to send back the visiting skipper. Great start for the hosts, this.
Back of a length closer to off stump, Kohli gets right behind the line and fends it towards point.
Fuller and outside off, Kohli presses forward and blocks it towards cover.
Length ball outside off, tapped to the off side for a single.
Full and outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away! Short ball but the line is down the leg side, Kohli swivels and pulls it away down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. There was a man there but this was placed finer.

RUN OUT MISSED! Things happening all of a sudden but West Indies aren't capitalizing on the luck. On a length on middle, worked on the leg side and Rahane is halfway down the track for the single but sent back late. The fielder isn't quick enough and that allows the batsman to get back in time.
Speared well outside off, Kohli doesn't offer a stroke to that one.
Short ball and this time Kohli reacts with an attempted pull but misses.
Back of a length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.

KOHLI SURVIVES! The extra bounce almost did him in this time. Shortish around off stump, Kohli is completely deceived by the extra bounce. Tries to fend at it but the ball lobs up off the splice of the blade. Excitement among the Windies players but unfortunately for them, the ball just flies over the gully fielder. Holder is livid. Single taken meanwhile.
Extra bounce! Shortish just outside off, rears up off the deck and takes Kohli completely by surprise. He evades it well in the end.
Shortish around off stump, defended firmly from the crease to the off side. Single taken.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Back of a length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Good length on middle, leans across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
On a length around off stump, blocked solidly from the crease by Kohli towards cover.
Good length on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Length ball on off stump, walks across and defends it down the track.
Fullish ball outside off, Rahane checks his square drive at the last moment. Towards the fielder at cover-point.
Good length outside off, Rahane stays in the crease and pats it towards point.
On middle and leg, leans across and clips it towards mid-wicket but this time the fielder makes a good effort with a dive to stop it.

FOUR! Loose ball and punished. West Indies have been guilty of gifting boundary deliveries at regular intervals and this has nullified their attempts at creating pressure. Low full toss on the pads, Kohli easily flicks it through mid-wicket with beautiful timing to get a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Kohli tries to cut but gets a bottom edge that rolls towards point. Wanted the single but is rightfully sent back by Rahane.
Slightly fuller this time outside off, Kohli controls the drive towards cover.
Good length outside off, Kohli shoulders arms to that one.
Back of a length on fourth stump line, left alone to the keeper.
On a length just around off stump, Rahane covers the line to defend well.
Good length closer to off stump, well left by Rahane.
Second slip comes out to short cover.
FOUR! CRASHED! Short and wide outside off, Rahane absolutely mauls the cut through point. Struck with absolute power and in the gap too as the ball rockets to the fence.
Fired on the pads, Rahane clips it through backward square leg for a couple.
Good ball! Dug in short around off stump, Rahane rises on his toes to block but the bounce does him in as he is struck on the glove.

Could have been close! Back of a length outside off, Kohli taps it towards short cover and the batsmen cross for the single. The man at cover was too slow to swoop in on the ball and that helped Kohli to get through despite his bat sticking a bit in the track.
On a shorter length well wide outside off, some movement but the line is well wide to make Rahane play.
FOUR! That's a gift and Rahane cashes in. Sprayed down the leg side and all that he had to do was to get bat on it. Glanced it gently down to the fine leg fence.
On the shorter side again outside off, doesn't rise much as Rahane misses the cut. The ball sneaks under the bat.
Short of a length outside off, Rahane hangs back and dabs it gently towards the gully region.
Back of a length outside off, nice shape for Holder as Ajinkya makes a leave.
Spears it very wide outside off, Rahane lets it pass.
Sharp bumper by Cummins, Kohli does well to evade it.
On a length around off, Kohli shuffles a bit and blocks it down the track.
Virat Kohli walks out to bat.

OUT! DHAWAN DEPARTS! He'll be bitterly disappointed with this dismissal. Short delivery that cramps him for room, he opts for the ramp over third man. The damp surface means that the bounce is a bit spongy and hence he only manages to pick out the fielder near the fence. Chase is the man there and he takes the catch with ease. Just the start WI would have wanted after opting to bowl.
Length ball on the pads, Rahane shuffles to glance it down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery that Rahane blocks firmly off the back foot.

FOUR! SLAPPED! Rahane is in sublime form and won't miss out on these freebies. Short and wide, he stays tall to punch it through backward point. Superb shot and third man had no chance of cutting it off.
On a length on off stump, Dhawan blocks it well from the crease.
The indipper from Holder but the line is a bit too straight. Raps Dhawan on the pads and the Windies players go up in appeal for lbw. Clearly going down leg. It was pitching outside leg too.
Full and outside off, Dhawn mistimes the drive past the bowler. The mid off fielder moves to his left to make the stop.
Holder strays on the pads, worked away down to fine leg for a single.
Good running! Shortish around off stump, dabbed gently near his crease to the adjacent practice pitch and they pinch a quick single. These two have been excellent with strike rotation in the series.
Back of a length around middle, sharp bounce off the deck and Rahane adjusts well in the end. Takes his bottom hand off as the ball pops off the glove. Single down to fine leg.
Jason Holder to take the other new ball.
Back of a length outside off, Rahane rocks back and eases it through the covers. Splits the gap to get a single.
Length ball angled into Rahane who defends solidly with the full face of the bat.
Good length outside off, Rahane lets it pass through to the keeper.

Almost a run out! Eventually, no harm done for the Indians. Shortish delivery that rises awkwardly at Dhawan. The dampness of the surface getting into the act. He rides the bounce to fend it towards the gully region. Slight mix up but they get the single in the end. A direct hit at the keeper's end might have been close.
On a length outside off, Rahane forces it off the back foot through backward point for a single. India are away.
Cummins tries to go very full, delivers a low full toss outside off, dug out towards mid off.

The umpires and players are making their way out in the middle. Ajinkya Rahane and Shikhar Dhawan will open the batting for India while Miguel Cummins will start the proceedings with the first new ball for West Indies.

PITCH REPORT - Jeff Dujon reckons that the track is quite a bit damp with a bit of odd coloring on it. Feels that batting first on this pitch won't be easy but adds that confidence is the key to succeed on such surfaces. Intent and determination will be required by the batsmen to pass the test. Ends by hoping that the weather remains good.

VIRAT KOHLI says that they have definitely played really good cricket. Mentions that a bit of moisture has sneaked in which could make a bit of difference. Informs that the wicket though is still hard. Reckons that the bowling unit was really solid in the last game and they will hope to continue in a similar manner as they have worked hard on it. Adds that the guys believe in themselves and the belief is a very important part to create such performance. Credits his guys for performing so well as they are quite passionate about the game.

JASON HOLDER says that they will bowl first. Feels that the surface is a bit damp and the conditions might aid the seamers. States that they want to make use of that. Reveals that there are three changes in the side, KESRICK WILLIAMS and KYLE HOPE are making their debuts while ROVMAN POWELL comes into the XI as well. Kieran Powell, Jonathan Carter and Alzarri Joseph are the ones sitting out. Doesn't feel that his side is batting-dependent and hopes that Windies can get their act together.
TOSS - WEST INDIES WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO FIELD!

India, on the other hand, were dominant in all the three departments of the game. They hardly got any competition from the home side. The tourists will hope to continue in the same way and also might just give the likes of Rishabh Pant and Dinesh Karthik a chance. The weather seems to be on the brighter side today and hopefully we will have an exciting game of cricket.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the 3rd ODI between West Indies and India. Meanwhile, Zimbabwe have beaten Sri Lanka in Sri Lanka for the first time and West Indies will hope to recreate such a scenario in Antigua. The hosts are struggling to compete with world class teams and it was quite visible in the last game where they hardly managed to compete. They would also know that the date for automatic qualification isn't far and they are currently not in a good position.
